artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan adding --skip-slow to verify-deploy.sh, wiring a real inline invocation into deploy-headless.sh with a new exit code 3, a fixture-driven regression suite, and documentation of the skill-orchestrate redeploy-checkpoint collision.

memory_candidates.content: When a producer script gains a gate that can fail on pre-existing conditions, pushing the downstream consumer's pre/post baseline-diff tolerance INTO the producer is structurally unsound whenever the acceptance scenario introduces its drift upstream of the producer's own pre-capture point: the injected drift is already present in the producer's baseline, so it classifies as pre-existing and the gate never fires on the exact case it must catch. The correct decomposition is a distinct new exit code in the producer (never overloading an existing one) plus a documented follow-up teaching the consumer to route that code through its existing baseline branches. The distinct exit code is the cheap discriminator that makes the follow-up a small edit rather than a redesign.
